For a standard *residential property,* | value mostly comes from | [COMPARABLE EVIDENCE.] What have *similar properties* | on similar streets | sold for [RECENTLY?] Size, | condition | and [LOCATION] | adjust the number from there. For an investment or commercial property, | the [RENT] it produces | matters *just as much* | as the comparables, | sometimes [MORE.] Two buildings | can look [IDENTICAL] | and sell for | *very different prices* | because the [INCOME] | behind them | is *different.* The first thing we look at | is the [INCOME.] What [RENT] | is the property producing, | and what rent | could it *reasonably* produce | if it were [LET?] This isn't just | a *headline* rent figure.
